title: HDFC Small Cap Fund - Monthly Scheme Factsheet

sections.content: HDFC Small Cap Fund is an open-ended equity scheme investing predominantly in small cap companies. As of October 2026, total Scheme AUM is ₹40,800.81 Crore. The Net Asset Value (NAV) for Direct Plan - Growth is ₹148.394. The fund is managed by Chirag Setalvad (Senior Executive Vice President, managing the fund since June 2014).

Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Plan is 0.80% per annum. Exit load: 1.00% if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 1 year from the date of allotment. Nil exit load if redeemed after 1 year (365 days) from allotment.

Benchmark: BSE 250 SmallCap Total Return Index (TRI). Asset Allocation: Equity holdings 92.80%, Cash and TREPS 7.20%. Top sector exposures: Capital Goods, Financial Services, Consumer Services, Chemicals, and Construction. Riskometer level: Very High Risk.
